title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow, you got so many! I'm sure the claw machine is happy you had fun as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right. I said I'd give you a reward if you got a lot, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I apologize. I said it on a whim, but I didn't give any thought as to what it would be…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What would be appropriate? I've seen game shows give away TVs, audio equipment, cars, or even a yacht…
choice_data_list: I want you to win a race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see! In that case, I'll win for sure!
